_comment: Extra stations not in the idanplus channels.json. This file is bundled as a fallback AND fetched from your repo every 24h (see EXTRA_STATIONS_URL in StationRepository.kt). Edit + push to add/update stations without rebuilding. Fields: id (unique), name, module ('radio' = direct play; supports regex/ch like channels.json), image (filename in assets/logos or http URL or ''), urls (ordered: primary first, then fallbacks).
